title: Quote drafts need the tradesperson's approval before they send
decision: Every quote the assistant drafts waits for the tradesperson to approve it before it goes to the customer.
success_signal: Wrong-line-item complaints fall below 5 a month by 2026-12-15 (illustrative), with quote send time no more than 1 day slower.
assumptions: Most wrong line items are caught when the tradesperson reads the draft
Approving each draft adds under a minute per quote
evidence: My call: we go with approve before send for every drafted quote.
